Started:   2026-03-09T04:14:15.367Z

─── Spec Context ───
Legacy Session Migration
Type: requirement
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  Read-only fallback for sessions stored on the kspec-meta shadow branch
  (.kspec/sessions/) from before the storage separation. Provides migration
  path with deprecation timeline.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-read-fallback]
    Given: A session ID is requested that does not exist in .kspec-sessions/

    When: Any session read operation executes (get, list, log show, log search)

    Then: Falls back to reading from .kspec/sessions/ on kspec-meta.
Result is returned normally — caller does not need to know the source.

  [ac-no-write]
    Given: Legacy sessions exist in .kspec/sessions/ on kspec-meta

    When: Any session write operation occurs (create, append, close, compact)

    Then: Writes always go to .kspec-sessions/, never to .kspec/sessions/.

  [ac-list-merge]
    Given: Sessions exist in both .kspec-sessions/ and .kspec/sessions/

    When: kspec session log list runs

    Then: Results include sessions from both locations, deduplicated by ID,
with .kspec-sessions/ taking precedence for duplicates.

  [ac-deprecation-warning]
    Given: A session is read from the legacy .kspec/sessions/ location

    When: The read completes

    Then: A deprecation warning is emitted (stderr, not stdout) noting
the legacy location. Warning includes guidance to run kspec session migrate.

  [ac-shadow-gitignore]
    Given: kspec setup or kspec init runs

    When: .kspec/sessions/ exists on kspec-meta

    Then: sessions/ is added to .kspec/.gitignore so no new session files
are tracked on kspec-meta. Existing history is preserved in git.

  [ac-migration-copy]
    Given: Legacy sessions exist in .kspec/sessions/

    When: kspec session migrate runs

    Then: Copies session directories from .kspec/sessions/ to .kspec-sessions/.
Does not delete originals.

  [ac-migration-idempotent]
    Given: Some sessions already exist in .kspec-sessions/

    When: kspec session migrate runs

    Then: Skips sessions that already exist in target.
Reports count of migrated and skipped sessions.


─── Notes ───

from .kspec/sessions/. Emit deprecation warning. Merge results in list
operations with dedup.
